disclaimer: License and capability facts are taken from each project's own model card / repository as of the evaluation date and are not legal advice. Verify the current terms at the source before commercial use. Speed, RAM/VRAM and real-time factor are only shown when measured by Voice Studio's built-in benchmark on your machine; naturalness is never scored because no listening (MOS) study was run.

models.name: Kokoro 82M v1.0
models.languages_note: The model also has voices for es, fr, hi, it, ja, pt, zh; Voice Studio ships only the English G2P.
models.emotion_note: No emotion conditioning. Markup is approximated with speaking rate, gain, punctuation-driven intonation and pause length; this does not guarantee genuine excitement.
models.hardware: CPU (all platforms); DirectML GPU on Windows; CoreML on macOS (falls back to CPU if unavailable)

models.name: Chatterbox (English)
models.runtime: Optional isolated Python worker (PyTorch 2.6, installed on demand with uv)
models.commercial_use: Allowed under MIT. Generated audio carries Resemble AI's Perth imperceptible watermark.
models.emotion_note: Has a real 'exaggeration' (emotion intensity) control used for excited/calm. It has no discrete 'mystery' emotion: mystery is approximated with low intensity plus longer pauses.
models.style_note: The reference clip conditions both identity and prosody; there is no separate identity/style control. 'Voice + Style' keeps the reference delivery (markup intensity off); 'Voice Only' lets markup drive intensity, but some reference cadence always carries over.
models.hardware: NVIDIA CUDA (recommended), Apple MPS, or CPU (slow, roughly several times slower than real time)

models.name: Chatterbox Multilingual
models.not_integrated_reason: Same worker could load it, but the markup/G2P path is English-only in this release.

models.name: Chatterbox Turbo
models.emotion_note: Paralinguistic tags (e.g. laughter); the exaggeration control is not supported.
models.not_integrated_reason: No intensity control, so it cannot honour excited/calm markup genuinely.

models.name: F5-TTS v1
models.commercial_use: Not allowed with the official checkpoints (non-commercial; trained on Emilia).
models.not_integrated_reason: Non-commercial weights; needs a reference transcript; evaluated as a second cloning backend for a later release.

models.name: XTTS-v2
models.not_integrated_reason: Non-commercial license; upstream company closed, unmaintained.

models.name: StyleTTS 2
models.license: Code MIT; pretrained models carry a usage condition
models.commercial_use: Pretrained-model terms require disclosing that speech is synthetic unless speakers consented. Check terms.
models.not_integrated_reason: Phonemizer depends on espeak-ng (GPL); zero-shot cloning is limited to the LibriTTS checkpoint and its usage condition.

models.name: Piper
models.license: Current project GPL-3.0 (original rhasspy/piper MIT, archived); each voice has its own dataset license
models.commercial_use: Depends on the voice's dataset license.
models.not_integrated_reason: ONNX-compatible but requires espeak-ng phonemes; no expressive or cloning capability beyond Kokoro.

models.name: MeloTTS
models.not_integrated_reason: No cloning or emotion control; overlaps with Kokoro.

models.name: OpenVoice V2
models.not_integrated_reason: Converts timbre on top of a base TTS; identity similarity is weaker than Chatterbox.

models.name: Parler-TTS v1 (mini / large)
models.emotion_note: Style is described in natural language; 34 named speakers, no reference cloning.
models.not_integrated_reason: No reference cloning.

models.name: Bark
models.not_integrated_reason: Unstable long-form output, no supported reference cloning.

models.name: OpenAudio S1-mini (Fish Speech)
models.not_integrated_reason: Non-commercial license.

models.name: CosyVoice 2 (0.5B)
models.not_integrated_reason: Heavy dependency stack (pynini/WeTextProcessing) with poor Windows support; strong candidate for a later worker.

models.name: Zonos v0.1
models.not_integrated_reason: Officially Linux-only (espeak-ng + CUDA); no supported Windows/macOS path.

models.name: Dia 1.6B
models.not_integrated_reason: Dialogue-oriented, speaker drift between generations without careful prompting.

models.name: Orpheus TTS 3B
models.license: Apache-2.0 code; weights derived from Llama 3.2 (Llama community license applies)
models.commercial_use: Subject to the Llama 3.2 community license.
models.not_integrated_reason: Too large for low-power target hardware; Llama license terms.

models.name: Sesame CSM-1B
models.not_integrated_reason: Gated download requiring an account (conflicts with the no-account goal).

models.name: IndexTTS-2
models.commercial_use: Custom terms; verify before commercial use.
models.not_integrated_reason: Custom license and large dependency footprint; the only evaluated model with explicit identity/emotion separation.

models.name: Spark-TTS 0.5B
models.not_integrated_reason: Non-commercial weights.

models.name: MaskGCT (Amphion)
models.not_integrated_reason: Non-commercial weights; heavy.

models.name: Kyutai TTS 1.6B
models.not_integrated_reason: The speaker encoder is not released, so user references cannot be cloned.

models.name: Higgs Audio v2
models.commercial_use: Restricted above a usage threshold; verify terms.
models.not_integrated_reason: Needs 24 GB-class GPU; far outside low-power targets.

models.name: VibeVoice
models.commercial_use: Research use; Microsoft restricted the repository after misuse reports. Not recommended.
models.not_integrated_reason: Research-only status and availability concerns.
